Definition: from G1537 and G3645; to extirpate:--destroy.
BiblicalUsage: exolothreúō turns up where the Bible says to destroy utterly. In Acts 3:23, the text says "shall be destroyed from among the people."
TheologicalSignificance: I take exolothreúō as it stands: to destroy utterly.
